column1: # Old HBase bugs that make an ad hoc check itself fail (owner 2026-10-26: only a bug whose witness fires the point's own
# declared throw counts; /users/ZhenyuLi/oldbug on node1, "fires this point's own throw"). Each runs the ad hoc check of
# its point on a tree of its own, graphchecker/hbase-checks with that bug put back by hand and a workload for it
# (experiments/hbase/trees.tsv, hbase-bug-<jira>). The case directory hbase-buggy-<jira> declares the check; its README
# the bug, the point, what was put back and why, and the result. A case's row is added with its directory.
